game.title: Yakuza Kiwami 2
game.blurb: Action-adventure brawler with RPG growth, set in Kamurocho and Sotenbori, from SEGA and Ryu ga Gotoku Studio, released 2017-12-07. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 3717340)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Yakuza_Kiwami_2
Fandom (yakuza.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://yakuza.fandom.com/wiki/Yakuza_Kiwami_2
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). Steam app 3717340 is listed in the Steam store list as "Yakuza Kiwami 2"; its schema calls the app "NEXUS2_K2" (an internal codename). It is the only Yakuza Kiwami 2 entry in the Steam app list that was fetched. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0). Of its 16 linked chapter pages only "Chapter 1" (about 1,300 characters), "Chapter 3" (about 1,300) and "Chapter 16" (about 2,800) exist; "Achievements and trophies" (about 10,400), "Substories" (about 1,900), "Controls", "Gameplay", "Walkthrough" (about 840) and "Table of Contents" also exist. Too little is written to use, so nothing was taken. yakuza.fandom.com answers the API, with about 54 linked pages, including "Yakuza Kiwami 2/Chapter 1" to "Chapter 16" and "Yakuza Kiwami 2/Majima Saga Chapter 1" to "Chapter 3"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 19 of 59 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions. "The Majima Factor" (hidden, 21.5%) was placed in a Majima Saga chapter by its name, because Fandom lists Majima Saga chapter pages; that is a judgement call. "YAKUZA KIWAMI 2" (hidden, 3.4%) and "Amon Defeated" (hidden, 7.2%) were placed with Legend mode by name as likely end-game goals; the other 16 hidden ones are named like story beats and sit in the main story chapter. "Repeat Offender" (destroy an establishment three times) and "Party Like it's 1988!" (10,000,000 yen) sit in the skills and combat chapter as a catch-all.
